source_conclusion:
[S1] Conclusions: Immediate provisionalization using natural crowns with FRC splints may reduce postoperative discomfort and improve overall esthetic outcomes while maintaining comparable gingival height stability during early healing.
[S2] Further research is required to assess esthetic and functional success with Type 1A treatments.
[S3] After achieving the desirable level of soft tissue, several techniques are available to achieve a precise transfer of molded gingival architecture, including customized impression coping, injection of soft material around the provisional restoration in the master cast, and digital impression.
[S4] However, such prosthesis may not be possible in patients with deep overbite due to interference with the retainers.
